LanguageData.RR_SettingsGlobalScope: Applies to all colonies. Changes are saved automatically.
LanguageData.RR_SettingsColonyScope: Applies to this colony. Changes are stored when you save the game.
LanguageData.RR_SettingsDefaultScope: Defaults for new colonies. Existing colonies keep their saved choices.
LanguageData.RR_SettingsLoadColony: Load a colony to change these options.
LanguageData.RR_SettingsTreeDormant: The body perk tree is inactive in Legacy mode. Its saved choice is retained for Balanced or Fantasy.
LanguageData.RR_SettingsIdleScope: Gain and Force Gain use the ordinary meal cycle. These options cover Recovery and pawns using legacy diet bars; the fullness trigger applies only to legacy diets.
LanguageData.RR_SettingsPersuasionScope: Ordinary body discussions use gradual preference changes. The old instant opinion abilities are developer tools and require developer mode plus god mode.
